title: Electrical Works Executive  (Kazakhstan)
desc:
What is the Summary of This Position?
In this role, you will manage the technical review, cost management, and execution of electrical projects while ensuring quality, regulatory compliance, and timely project delivery.
What You'll Be Doing?
To review, evaluate, and verify electrical projects from a technical perspective, and to manage the required revision processes,
To assess the compliance of projects with the applicable local standards and regulations, and to coordinate the necessary adaptation activities,
To carry out cost estimation, quantity take-off, and budget planning activities for mechanical projects,
To supervise manufacturing, installation, and on-site construction activities on behalf of the Employer, ensuring compliance with project requirements, technical specifications, and quality standards,
To monitor and coordinate subcontractors' activities, ensuring that the works are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with technical requirements,
Taking an active role in the planning, budgeting, and project management of mechanical works within investment and construction projects, as well as monitoring and controlling field activities.
Which Profile Are We Looking For?
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering,
Minimum 10 years of experience in the technical evaluation, cost estimation, and implementation of electrical projects,
Proven experience in budget planning, cost analysis, and tender management,
Proven experience in project management, budget and cost control, and subcontractor management,
Knowledge of Kazakhstan standards and regulations is preferred. Proficiency in Russian and/or Kazakh is preferred. Good command of English is an asset,
Proficient in MS Office applications.
Nobel’s proven excellence in the global pharmaceutical sector is driven by the dedication and expertise of our people. Since 1954, we have grown from our roots in Türkiye into a global pharmaceutical company, thanks to the dedication and expertise of nearly 5,000 colleagues.
We operate 5 R&D and production hubs across Türkiye, Kazakhstan, and Uzbekistan, and our presence spans 24 countries with dedicated local teams. Our multicultural and multinational colleagues embody our global presence, ensuring that our products reach patients in more than 50 countries.
What unites us is our mission:
Health for All, Access for All.
